title: Product Delivery & Agile Execution Case
summary: A delivery playbook shaped by real sprint execution: clearer stories, tighter QA/UAT alignment, and smoother releases.
problem: Delivery slowed when requirements were ambiguous, QA/UAT alignment happened late, and release readiness was inconsistent. Stakeholders needed predictable execution and clear communication.
approach: Translated business pain points into user stories with acceptance criteria, supported backlog grooming and sprint planning, coordinated QA/UAT, and maintained release documentation so teams shipped with fewer surprises.
outcome: Improved release readiness and helped reduce deployment cycle time by ~40% while improving backend responsiveness by ~25% (as reported during the role).
